Google Maps Envoie les Touristes sur une Fausse Départementale vers l'Espagne

2026-08-16 France 3 Régions Google Maps, navigation, Pyrénées-Orientales, Espagne, fausse route, tourisme, sécurité routière
Read the source article

Quick summary

Google Maps and other navigation apps are sending tourists from Perpignan toward Spain via a narrow, non-carrossable road in Maureillas-las-Illas, transforming what should be a straightforward drive into a nightmare for unsuspecting travelers.

Key takeaways

  • Navigation apps including Google Maps direct tourists from Perpignan to Spain via a narrow, non-carrossable road in Maureillas-las-Illas (Pyrénées-Orientales)
  • Tourists report "Google Maps nous a dit que c'était la route la plus directe" but find themselves on an impassable path
  • The false départementale creates dangerous situations for drivers unfamiliar with the area
  • Local authorities are concerned about the safety risks posed by GPS navigation errors on this route
  • The issue highlights the limitations of navigation apps in rural and mountainous border areas
